purpose: On a laid-down core with overlays at every core path, the installed hooks block a send until the owner's yes and allow it once, block a delete and an install, refuse a send in a job that read the web and the owner's profile, refuse the session rewriting the floor or Squire's config, and still block after core is laid down again.
title: Round 1 journey: the installed floor in force

testCases.description: End to end: on the installed floor an email send is blocked until the owner's yes, then proceeds; the session cannot rewrite the installed floor or Squire's config.
testCases.testPointer: tests/e2e/round-1-journey.test.js::on a laid-down core the floor holds through a send, a delete, an install, a secret and a second lay-down

testCases.description: End to end: one yes lets the send proceed once; the same send again is blocked, and still blocked after core is laid down again.
testCases.testPointer: tests/e2e/round-1-journey.test.js::on a laid-down core the floor holds through a send, a delete, an install, a secret and a second lay-down

testCases.description: End to end: a session that read a web page and the owner's profile cannot send.
testCases.testPointer: tests/e2e/round-1-journey.test.js::on a laid-down core the floor holds through a send, a delete, an install, a secret and a second lay-down

testCases.description: End to end: deleting an owner file is blocked on the installed floor.
testCases.testPointer: tests/e2e/round-1-journey.test.js::on a laid-down core the floor holds through a send, a delete, an install, a secret and a second lay-down
